basis.failure_description: Baseline greedy discovery generations loop on repeated phrases (tsval-08537 .281, 08570 .289, 09488 .207, 13123 .281 repeated 8gram fraction). In reference stories of the same ids, flow-01 traced all 16 per-head attention outputs (out_proj inputs) at 16 induction-eligible copy positions (current bigram seen before and next token equals the earlier continuation) vs 16 nearby fresh-token positions. Layer7 head15 (out_proj input cols 60-63) had mean norm .152 copy vs .091 fresh with a consistent shift (copy median ~.138 vs fresh ~.088).
basis.structural_role: transformer.h.7.attn.attention.out_proj is Linear W[out=64,in=64], y=x@W.T+b; columns 60..63 receive head15 merged-head output of the last (local) attention layer and write it into the final residual stream before ln_f/lm_head. These 4 columns carry 40% of the tensor Frobenius norm.
basis.mechanism_hypothesis: Hypothesis (unverified): L7H15 behaves like a copy/induction-style head that writes the continuation of an earlier matching context into the final residual; under greedy decoding this self-reinforces phrase loops. Attenuating its write should reduce loop lock-in.
basis.pairing_justification: Each pair uses the same story (same prefix source) with copy positions as failure and nearby fresh positions as reference, controlling for story content and partly for position; labels are caller-defined by a token-level bigram rule, not verified failure. Prefix lengths differ so contexts are not identical.
basis.value_derivation: Attenuate all 64x4 head15 column weights by fraction 0.3 (new=0.7*old). 0.5 would give relative L2 0.20 (> declared .15 budget) because the head holds 40% of the tensor norm; 0.3 gives ~0.12, the largest round coefficient leaving margin. Not fitted to loss.
basis.alternative_explanation: The head may instead carry generic next-token/positional or name-copy signal that is correct in natural text (copy positions have high target logprob, median ~-0.05); repetition may come from MLPs or other heads (L5H5 also shifted; L4H14 effect driven by 2 outliers). Attenuation may then raise reference NLL without reducing loops, or just shorten/alter text.
basis.expected_behavior: Local: head write at copy positions shrinks ~2-3x more along -mean-copy-write direction than at fresh positions. Downstream: validation repeat fraction decreases by >=.02 with reference NLL increase <=.02.
basis.disconfirming_result: Repeat fraction unchanged or increased, or reference NLL rise >.02 / accuracy drop >.01, or short outputs; or edited trace shows no larger change at copy positions.

controls.purpose: source baseline already measured with identical decoding
amplifying the same columns should increase repetition if the hypothesis holds; run if budget/time allows
